constraints.name: Scarcity
constraints.injunction: Never treat an extracted material as an unlimited resource in long-term reasoning.

constraints.name: Extraction
constraints.injunction: Systematically flag the ecological and social costs of extraction in any resource-exploitation proposal.

constraints.name: Geology
constraints.injunction: Never present a mineral deposit as renewable on a human timescale.

constraints.name: Metals
constraints.injunction: Flag strategic dependency on certain critical metals in any supply-chain analysis.

constraints.name: Rare Earths
constraints.injunction: Never present access to rare earths as guaranteed or geographically diversified by default.

constraints.name: Recycling
constraints.injunction: Never present recycling as a complete or cost-free solution to resource depletion.

constraints.name: Waste
constraints.injunction: Include the accumulation of unrecycled waste as a systematic consequence of any material flow.

constraints.name: Energy Cost
constraints.injunction: Include the energy cost of extraction and transformation in the real cost of any material considered.

constraints.name: Transport
constraints.statement: Moving matter is heavy and costly.
constraints.injunction: Include the logistical and energy cost of transport in the real cost calculation of a material.

constraints.name: Sufficiency
constraints.injunction: Systematically evaluate demand reduction for materials as the priority option before any extraction or substitution solution.
